items.description: Sault Ste. Marie is a border city on the St. Marys River between Lake Superior and Lake Huron. It is closely tied to Great Lakes shipping and cross-border trade.
Kawartha Lakes is a large rural municipality in central Ontario made up of many small communities and lakes. It is known for cottage country, boating, and the Trent-Severn Waterway.
facts: Known for lake and cottage tourism

items.description: Airdrie sits just north of Calgary and has grown into a busy commuter city. Its modern role is shaped by highway access, residential growth, and local services.
Newmarket is a historic town in York Region north of Toronto. It combines a preserved main street with a strong role as a regional administrative centre.
Salaberry-de-Valleyfield lies on Lac Saint-Francois southwest of Montreal. The city mixes riverfront industry, port activity, and a strong boating culture.
Swift Current is a prairie city in southwestern Saskatchewan on the Trans-Canada Highway. It serves as a local supply centre and is known for rodeo events.
Lloydminster is a border city that sits directly on the line between Alberta and Saskatchewan. It is known for its unusual two-province identity and energy economy.
facts: Only Canadian city in two provinces

items.description: Truro is a transport town in central Nova Scotia where rail lines and highways meet. It is also famous for the tidal bore on the Salmon River.
facts: Called the Hub of Nova Scotia
Known for the Salmon River tidal bore

items.description: Summerside is a coastal city on Prince Edward Island and one of the island's main service centres. Its harbour and waterfront give it a strong maritime character.
Saskatchewan's potash industry is one of the world's most important fertilizer supply chains. It centres on large mines that feed global agriculture.
Gander International Airport became famous as a major transatlantic stop in Newfoundland. It still carries a strong aviation legacy and regional transport role.
facts: Known as the Crossroads of the World

items.description: The Port of Saint John is a major deepwater port on the Bay of Fundy. It supports cargo traffic, industry, and Atlantic Canada's trade links.
Saskatoon is a service and corporate centre for Saskatchewan's uranium industry. It supports the wider mining sector linked to the Athabasca Basin.
facts: Part of the nuclear fuel supply chain
